## Core Engineering Stack
Frontend: Next.js 14, React 18/19, TypeScript, Three.js, GSAP
Backend: Node.js, Express, Go, Python, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, Redis
DevOps: Docker, AWS, Cloudflare, cPanel/LiteSpeed
AI & ML: PyTorch, LangChain, OpenAI API, Llama 3, HuggingFace
